summary: Eligibility challenge to Chairperson appointment under National Commission for Homeopathy Act, 2020; 'leader' defined as Head of Department/Organisation requiring 10 years experience; Search Committee's flawed verification process; High Court Division Bench erroneously deferred to Committee's assessment without examining documentary evidence; Government's post-hoc validation letter improperly relied upon; judicial review scope in expert appointments; appointment quashed due to non-fulfillment of statutory eligibility criteria.
legal_provisions_cited: National Commission for Homeopathy Act, 2020 s.4(2)
Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
Article 77 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court Division Bench judgment set aside; Single Judge's order quashing appointment restored; Search Committee directed to reconstitute selection process.
